## State of the Ecosystem (SOE) reporting
### Improving ecosystem information and synthesis for fishery managers

:::: {.soe-50-50-slide}

::: {}

- Ecosystem indicators linked to management objectives `r Cite(myBib, "depiper_operationalizing_2017")`
    + Contextual information
    + Report evolving since 2016
    + Fishery-relevant subset of full Ecosystem Status Reports

- Open science emphasis `r Cite(myBib, "bastille_improving_2020")`

- Used within Mid-Atlantic Fishery Management Council's Ecosystem Process `r Cite(myBib, "muffley_there_2020")`

:::

## 2026 Report Structure

:::: {.soe-50-50-slide}

::: {.soe-50-column}

1. Graphical summary
    + Page 1 report card re: performance metrics
    + Page 2 risk summary bullets
    + Page 3 2025 snapshot
1. Performance relative to management objectives
    - *What* does the indicator say--up, down, stable?
    - *Why* do we think it is changing: explore drivers
1. Risks to meeting management objectives
    - Same *What* and *Why* as Performance Section
1. 2025 Highlights

:::

::: {.soe-50-column}

```{r, fig.alt = ""}
knitr::include_graphics("https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/presentations/raw/master/docs/EDAB_images//SystemDrivers_v5.jpg")
```

:::

## Metrics, risks, drivers, and indicators

```{r management-objectives}
perf_metrics <- tibble::tibble(
  "Objective Categories" = c("Seafood Production",
                             "Profits","Recreation",
                             "Stability",
                             "Social & Cultural",
                             "Protected Species"),
  "Indicators reported" = c("Landings; commercial total and by feeding guild; recreational harvest",
                           "Revenue decomposed to price and volume, profitability",
                           "Angler trips; recreational fleet diversity; recreational catch diversity",
                           "Fishery and ecosystem volatility, adaptive capacity, and shifts from baseline",
                           "Community commercial fishing activity and risk factors
",
                           "Bycatch; population (adult and juvenile) numbers, mortalities"),
  service = "Performance Metrics"
)

drivers <- tibble::tibble(
  "Objective Categories" = c("Management",
                             "Biomass",
                             "Environment"),
  "Indicators reported" = c("Stock status; catch compared with catch limits",
                           "Biomass or abundance by feeding guild from surveys",
                           "Climate and ecosystem risk indicators listed below"),
  service = "Drivers of Performance"
)

risks <- tibble::tibble("Objective Categories" = c(
  "Risks to Managing Spatially",
  "Risks to Managing Seasonally",
  "Risks to Setting Catch Limits",
  "Other Ocean Uses"
),
"Indicators reported" = c(
  "Fish and cetacean distribution shifts",
  "Spawning and migration timing",
  "Fish condition and recruitment",
  "Fishery revenue and landings from wind lease areas by species and port"
),
service = "Risks to Meeting Objectives"
)

drivers_risk <- tibble::tibble("Objective Categories" = c(
  "Habitat and prey quality",
  "Phenology",
  "Drivers of productivity",
  "Other Ocean Uses"
),
"Indicators reported" = c(
  "Benthic and pelagic forage distribution; ocean temperature; changes in currents and Cold Pool",
  "Habitat timing: length of ocean summer, cold pool seasonal persistence",
  "Benthic and pelagic forage quality and abundance; ocean temperature and acidification",
  "Wind development map; protected species presence and hotspots"
),
service = "Drivers of Risks"
)

mng_obj <- rbind(perf_metrics, drivers, risks, drivers_risk)

flextable::as_grouped_data(mng_obj, groups = "service") |> 
  flextable::as_flextable(hide_grouplabel=TRUE) |>
  flextable::align(i = ~ !is.na(service), align = "left") |> 
  flextable::bold(i = ~ !is.na(service), bold = TRUE) |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(Objective.Categories = "Objective categories",
                               Indicators.reported = "Indicators reported") |>
  
  flextable::set_caption("Ecosystem-scale fishery management objectives") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 12,
                      part = "all") |>
    flextable::theme_zebra() |>
    flextable::bg(i = ~ !is.na(service), bg = "beige", part = "body") |>
    flextable::hline(i = ~ !is.na(service)) |>
  flextable::autofit() 
```

Key to figures

```{r , eval = FALSE}
a <- ecodata::plot_species_dist(varName = "along", n=10) + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE)
b <- ecodata::plot_species_dist(varName = "depth", n=10) + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) 

ggpubr::ggarrange(a, b, ncol = 2)
```  

```{r}
#| out-height: "450px"
knitr::include_graphics(here::here("images/plot_key.png"))
```

Long-term trends assessed only for 30+ years: [more information](https://noaa-edab.github.io/tech-doc/trend-analysis.html)

Short-term trends assessed for last 10 years of data OR a full time series <30 years

<p style="color:#FF8C00;">Orange line = significant increase</p>
<p style="color:#9932CC;">Purple line = significant decrease</p>
<p>No color line = not significant or < 30 years</p>
<p style="background-color:#D3D3D3;">Grey background = last 10 years</p>

:::
